claims.claim: C1: Age-dependent posterior re-weighting of provisionally-clean commits (LAW) improves online JIT-SDP over waiting-time baselines
closest_prior: Liu et al. 2024a PU learning for JIT-SDP, Empir Softw Eng 29(5):98 — NOT YET OPENED
claims.exact_difference: ODaSC derives label confidence from feature-space micro-clusters for examples already labelled clean after W days; LAW derives it from commit age via a right-truncation-corrected discovery-delay distribution combined with model risk, and also trains on commits younger than W. Difference vs CVR methods: domain transfer + truncation-aware nonparametric delay estimate (weaker).
claims.status: open — Liu 2024a could not be located (UNVERIFIED citation); ODaSC pre-empts the problem formulation, so C1 rests on the estimator + using commits younger than W; ODaSC to be added as baseline (plan_v2)

claims.claim: C2 (Type A/C): waiting time barely denoises labels; its effect is mainly class-composition shift of recent data
claims.status: model-free evidence on 14 projects; needs a model-based confirmation (E3 diag)

claims.claim: C3: Under verification latency, label-policy differences in online JIT-SDP are mainly operating-point effects; a latency-aware decision threshold (LAT: G-mean-optimal threshold on recent prequential scores with delay-survival-weighted provisional labels) beats fixed waiting times and generic mature-label threshold moving (MAT)
closest_prior: ORB (Cabral et al. 2019): adjusts class weights from the predicted-positive moving average
claims.exact_difference: LAT sets the decision threshold from recent scored commits whose provisional labels are weighted by a right-truncation-corrected discovery-delay survival, so it can use commits younger than any waiting time; ORB changes training weights toward a fixed target positive rate, GHOST/MAT use only labelled/mature data, ODaSC changes sampling not the threshold.
claims.status: open - 10 OpenAlex queries (C3_latency_threshold) found no pre-emption; needs E0b/E1b evidence and a second search round with different phrasings before writing
